status: frozen metadata correction after the wrong-field Gaia cone exposed the preregistered PLCK center transcription error, before querying the corrected PLCK cone, matching any PLCK X-ray source, or constructing any temperature map; the unchanged AS295 match outcomes are already known

metadata_correction.reason: The reduction protocol transcribed PLCK G287 as 10:50:49.40 +28:04:44.30. The downloaded Chandra event WCS is centered near 11:50 -28 degrees, and the Chandra X-ray Center lists 11:50:49.2 -28:04:37. This is an object-coordinate transcription error, not a fitted astrometric or physics correction.

purpose: Register every frozen Chandra observation to the Gaia DR3 ICRS frame with one translation-only rule before constructing the v17A temperature maps.

archive.selection: all Gaia DR3 sources in the frozen cone; no magnitude, proper-motion, or RUWE cut

epoch_propagation.target_epoch: midpoint of DATE-OBS and DATE-END for each ObsID, expressed as Julian year
epoch_propagation.five_or_six_parameter_sources: linear tangent-plane propagation using pmra=mu_alpha*cos(dec) and pmdec from Gaia DR3
epoch_propagation.two_parameter_sources: retain the Gaia DR3 reference-epoch position and uncertainty; do not invent a proper motion
epoch_propagation.parallax_and_perspective_acceleration: not applied because the frozen 2-arcsec match radius and 0.5-arcsec residual gate dominate these terms for this use

xray_source_selection.catalog: the already frozen binsize-2 0.5-7 keV wavdetect catalog

matching.failure_rule: Fail the cluster map if any contributing ObsID has fewer than three final source pairs or exceeds the final RMS gate; do not widen the radius, relax the residual gate, or fit rotation/scale.

application.update: apply the fitted transform to every aspect solution for the ObsID, then regenerate science and blank-sky event sky coordinates from the corrected aspect solution
application.relative_check: after absolute correction, verify all contributing ObsIDs against the greatest-cleaned-exposure reference observation for the cluster
application.reference_observation: greatest cleaned exposure, with lower ObsID breaking a tie
